tone.title: Wizard Modern Classic MCII 100W (E34L) "MultiLoad" community pack — Amp Head
tone.description:
🅰️2️⃣ ready 

Get the ✨full✨ Wizard Modern Classic MCII 100W (E34L) "MultiLoad" pack here:

👉 https://ko-fi.com/2dornam/shop 🙏

The Wizard Modern Classic MCII 100W is a premium, hand-built boutique tube amplifier crafted in Canada by Rick St. Pierre, long-time tour tech for AC/DC. This amp uses E34L power tubes.

😮 Parametric (PRE, POW) models (Genome) in the full Ko-Fi pack

ℹ️ “MultiLoad” - what’s this about?

The cabinet (or load) a tube amplifier interacts with has a considerable impact on the tone & feel. 
For this pack, I used 2 iconic cabinets and reamped all settings with each cab.

ℹ️ Summary

This release features a Wizard Modern Classic MCII 100W amp captured using 2 iconic cabinets loading down the amplifier. 

✅ All profiles calibrated
✅ NAM A2 - all profiles trained with A2 from original audio
☑️ Parametric (PRE and POW) models for Two Notes Genome
✅ 2 iconic guitar cabs used as loads (no reactive load):
🟣 Mesa 4x12 OS Straight
🟣 Marshall 4x12 1960BV with Marshall G12 Vintage speakers
✅ AMP, PRE & POW profiles for maximum flexibility
✅ DI and MIC-ed up flavors for each AMP & POW profile
✅ Custom, extended anti-aliasing signal used for reamping
✅ High-fidelity, low-noise, linear signal chain for reamping
✅ Stompbox / OD profiles included

The full Ko-Fi pack includes:

• 128 x AMP settings (1 x DI and 5 mic-ed up, full-rig flavors for every knob combination used)
• 72 x POW settings (1 x DI and 5 mic-ed up, full-rig flavors for every knob combination used)
• 50 x PRE settings
• 50 x OD pedal settings
• 6 x parametric PRE (isolated preamp) models for Two Notes Genome
• 2 x parametric POW (isolated poweramp, DI) models for Two Notes Genome; one for each cabinet (Mesa 4x12 and Marshall 4x12)

TOTAL: over 1,200 individual NAM files + 8 parametric models

✅ Efficiency 

Streamlined for users across platforms (Dimehead, Valeton GP-5 etc), AMP & POW profiles offer 6 flavors:

• DI = raw poweramp <-> cab signal tapped with a DI box, no Microphone 
• SM57 = full-rig chain, cab mic-ed with a Shure SM57 on the top-left speaker
• SM58 = full-rig chain, cab mic-ed with a Shure SM58 on the top-right speaker
• BLEND #1: full-rig chain, cab mic-ed with 2 mics (Shure SM57 & SM58) blended
• BLEND #2: full-rig chain, cab mic-ed with 2 mics (Shure SM57 & SM58 @ +4dB) blended
• BLEND #3: full-rig chain, cab mic-ed with 2 mics (Shure SM57 @ +4dB & SM58) blended

⚙️ Reamp chain details

• RME Fireface UCX II -> Lehle P-SPLIT III -> Wizard Modern Classic MCII 100W -> St.Rock React:IR II (Mesa 4x12 OS Straight / Marshall 4x12 1960BV) -> RME Fireface UCX II

• SEND level: 18.995 dBu

Use the "Calibration" feature (video linked) in the NAM plugin to get the most out of these profiles: 

https://www.neuralampmodeler.com/post/neuralampmodelerplugin-v0-7-12-is-released

• [AMP] = full head (pre & poweramp)
• [PRE] = preamp only (no poweramp)
• [POW] = poweramp only (no preamp)
• [OD] = overdrive pedal
• STD (A2) = new go-to NAM A2 standard architecture
• HI = high sensitivity input on amp used
• LO = low sensitivity input on amp used
• RT = Rhythm channel
• RT+ = Rhythm channel with overdrive / boost pedal
• RTK = Rhythm channel with "Black Cat" mod 
• RTK+ = Rhythm channel with "Black Cat" mod & overdrive / boost pedal
• LD = Lead channel
• LD+ = Lead channel with overdrive / boost pedal
• TSMINI = Tube Screamer Mini
• MXRM77 = MXR Custom Badass Modified O.D.
• FORTIN14 = Fortin Fourteen
• DWHAMER = PedalPCB Dwarven Hammer
• DFXKoD = DemonFX King of Drive
• DFXKLON = DemonFX Centaur
• DFXDBOOST = DemonFX Dual Boost, Exotic EP mode
• JR.TheJef = J.Rockett Audio Designs The Jeff Archer
• GRIND = Fortin Grind
• ODD = Warm Audio ODD
• BO$$ = Boss GE-7 Equalizer
